D/ [FL] IVL CONSTANT[IVS NOB C] ; R/ [PROVIDENT]IAE CAESS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Providentiae Caess issue of 324-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [FL] IVL CONSTANT[IVS NOB C]. Reverse description: Camp gate, two towers, star above. Reverse inscription: [PROVIDENT]IAE CAESS. This coin was kindly identified by Cliff Reeves.
